name: Aluminum
description: Widely used metal; some studies investigate links to neurotoxicity but limited cancer relevance.

name: Silicon
description: Common in the environment and used in biomedical devices; biologically inert.

name: Phosphorus
description: Vital for DNA, RNA, and ATP; critical for energy transfer and cell signaling.

name: Sulfur
description: Important for amino acids and enzymes; involved in cell metabolism.

name: Chlorine
description: Essential electrolyte as chloride ion; chlorine compounds can be toxic.

name: Potassium
description: Key electrolyte involved in cell signaling and muscle contraction.

name: Calcium
description: Crucial in cell signaling, apoptosis, and bone structure.

name: Scandium
description: Limited biological role; some research into rare earth metals in medicine.

name: Titanium
description: Used in implants and prosthetics due to excellent biocompatibility.

name: Vanadium
description: Trace element studied for insulin mimetic effects and potential anticancer properties.

name: Chromium
description: Essential in trace amounts but certain forms (Cr VI) are carcinogenic.
